# Weston Engineers

> Weston Engineers is a project management consultancy (PMC) and construction company based in New Town, Rajarhat, Kolkata, West Bengal, India. It serves developers, builders, landowners, architects, institutions, government agencies, and homeowners across Kolkata and West Bengal.

## Services

Weston Engineers provides 32+ services grouped into five categories:

- **Project Management Consultancy & Civil Engineering Consulting** — independent PMC oversight, contractor coordination, look-ahead scheduling, BOQ and billing verification, feasibility and due diligence. See: https://westonengineer.com/services/project-management-consultancy.html
- **Construction & Building** — new building construction, custom home building, home additions, accessory building construction. See: https://westonengineer.com/services/construction-building.html
- **Concrete & Foundation** — concrete construction and pouring, foundation installation, drainage, slab foundations. See: https://westonengineer.com/services/concrete-foundation.html
- **Renovation, Repairs & Finishing** — home renovations, structural repairs, roof and flooring repair, tile work, painting. See: https://westonengineer.com/services/renovation-repairs.html
- **Site Works & Infrastructure** — excavation, demolition, road and deck construction. See: https://westonengineer.com/services/site-works-infrastructure.html

Full list: https://westonengineer.com/services.html

## Location & Service Area

Kolkata, New Town, Rajarhat, and West Bengal, India. Registered address: Ambey Garden, Banglakhi Awasan, Road Dash Drone, Chinarpark, Kolkata, West Bengal 700136. Established 2015. GSTIN 19GAWPS7609F2ZQ. Enlisted civil contractor with Bidhannagar Municipal Corporation. EPFO-registered employer.

## Leadership

Weston Engineers is founded and led by Firoz Shaikh, a civil engineer (M.Tech) who personally oversees the company's site supervision and technical advisory practice. He is also Founder & Managing Partner of Nafcon Realty, a real estate development company operating in New Town and Salt Lake, Kolkata. See: https://westonengineer.com/about.html

## What makes Weston Engineers different

Weston Engineers operates as an independent project management consultancy, meaning it represents the client's interests rather than a contractor's — verifying billing against BOQ, inspecting site quality daily, and coordinating contractors and schedules on the client's behalf. Its three core principles are site discipline, transparent billing, and on-time delivery.

## Infrastructure PMC record
- Weston Engineers provided project management consultancy to the contractor Azad Enterprise on 12 certified public works for KMDA, NKDA and PHED West Bengal (2016-2026), worth over Rs 35 crore: RCC elevated service reservoirs under AMRUT (Kamarhati, Bidhannagar, Haringhata, Furfura Sharif), the Arjunpukur piped water supply scheme, 1,000 mm DI and MS rising mains for arsenic-affected blocks (Haroa, Rajarhat, Bhangar-II), a 600 mm sewer line in New Town AA-IIG, the NKDA hawker market opposite Unitech Gate No. 2, and barrier-free footpaths in New Town AA-ID. Details: https://westonengineer.com/projects.html#pmc-infrastructure
